nvitk.segmentation.total_segmentator
====================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.segmentation.total_segmentator

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   TotalSegmentator integration: thin CLI wrapper + the class-to-label maps we use.

   Usage::

       from nvitk.segmentation.total_segmentator import run_totalsegmentator, get_class_id

       run_totalsegmentator(
           input="/path/to/CT.nii.gz",
           output="/path/to/out_dir",
           task="total",
           roi_subset=["vertebrae_L4", "vertebrae_L3"],
       )
       l4_id = get_class_id("vertebrae_L4", "total")  # -> 28

.. py:function:: totalseg_cli(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, task: str, roi_subset: tuple[str, Ellipsis], device: str, submit: str, multilabel: bool, statistics: bool, fast: bool, preview: bool, model_dir: pathlib.Path | None, container: pathlib.Path | None, models_dir: pathlib.Path | None, src_dir: pathlib.Path | None, input_root: pathlib.Path | None, output_root: pathlib.Path | None, log_dir: pathlib.Path | None, err_dir: pathlib.Path | None, project: str | None, account: str | None, ngpu: int | None, h_vmem: str | None, queue: str | None, job_name: str | None, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, remote_host: str | None, remote_user: str | None, display_progress: bool, dry_run: bool) -> None

   Run TotalSegmentator either locally or on SGE.


.. py:function:: run_totalsegmentator(input: str | pathlib.Path, output: str | pathlib.Path, task: str, *, device: str = 'gpu', roi_subset: Iterable[str] | None = None, multilabel: bool = True, statistics: bool = True, fast: bool = False, preview: bool = False, model_dir: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, extra_env: dict[str, str] | None = None, check: bool = True, capture_output: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess

   Invoke the ``TotalSegmentator`` CLI on *input* and write to *output*.

   :param input: Single NIfTI file or a directory of NIfTI files.
   :param output: Output directory. Created if absent.
   :param task: One of :data:`AVAILABLE_TASKS` (passed via ``-ta``).
   :param device: ``'gpu'`` or ``'cpu'`` (passed via ``--device``).
   :param roi_subset: ROI whitelist appended via ``-rs`` (``None`` means all ROIs).
   :param multilabel: Pass ``--ml`` (single multilabel NIfTI output). Default True.
   :param statistics: Pass ``--statistics``. Default True.
   :param fast: Forwarded to ``--fast`` / ``--preview``.
   :param preview: Forwarded to ``--fast`` / ``--preview``.
   :param model_dir: Optional path exported as ``TOTALSEG_HOME_DIR`` for the subprocess.
   :param extra_env: Additional environment variables for the subprocess.

   :returns: The completed process. Raises :class:`subprocess.CalledProcessError`
             when *check* is True and the CLI exits non-zero.
   :rtype: subprocess.CompletedProcess
